subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: The existing repository-config policy authorization and closed-parse guarantees remain in force for routing overrides.
rationale: a routing override is critical governing policy, not an ordinary worker-authored preference
fit_criterion: an operator-authorized override can become effective; contributor-only, worker-authored, unknown-key, and unauthenticated changes cannot; existing config-policy suites remain green
